mechanism_narrative: A 2% quarterly increase in Real GDP (GDPC1) indicates strengthening economic growth, leading to increased consumer spending and, subsequently, higher S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters with 2%+ GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, S&P 500 forward returns tend to decline over the next 20 trading days due to increased borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 55% of tightening periods, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 6% and PAYEMS increases by 200,000+ in a month, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 returns tend to rise over the next 5 trading days due to increased consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 30% of triggered instances, or joint Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 5% monthly increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) indicates supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as manufacturers' profitability increases.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window, or SPX returns are not significantly higher in months following 5%+ INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS (Retail and Food Services Sales) increases by 1%+ month-over-month, indicating strong consumer demand, S&P 500 returns tend to increase over the next 5 trading days as retail sector stocks boost the market.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, the level of FEDFUNDS inversely correlates with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as higher rates increase borrowing costs and decrease equity valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation coefficient remains above -0.02 over any 5-year rolling window, or SPX returns are not significantly lower in periods with high FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE is below 7% and PAYEMS growth is positive, signaling a stable labor market, the S&P 500 tends to experience lower volatility over the next 20 trading days, leading to positive returns in a risk-on environment.
failure_condition: SPX experiences > 2% daily volatility in > 50% of triggered periods, or joint Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 10% year-over-year increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand for new housing, leading to increased economic activity and, subsequently, higher S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or SPX returns are not significantly higher in periods following 10%+ HOUST growth (t-test p > 0.10).
